name: nf-hvac-functional-test
description: Runs an AHU functional test with an optional VAV max-cooling-airflow step. Dry-run is the default. Writes use a BACnet priority from 3 to 16 (default 8).

layer.name: ftest
layer.description: Shadow samples for functional test runs

options.name: siteConfig
options.description: Site configuration JSON. Point UUIDs and generic equipment ids only. Dry-run defaults to true.

options.name: enabled
options.description: When false, the engine tick does no work.

options.name: enableSimulator
options.description: When true AND simulatorConfirm is CREATE_LOCAL_SIM, the sim hook creates and updates new local BACnet objects for a fake AHU/VAV/reheat bench. Default false. Does not write to real devices or existing points.

options.name: simulatorConfirm
options.description: Must be exactly CREATE_LOCAL_SIM to allow the simulator to create new local objects. Leave empty on a normal install.
